# Superseded calibration comparison

This folder preserves the report's earlier comparison of two 12 October 2026
calibration runs. It is historical material, not the current model status.

The report now reads `final/outputs/tables/metacommunity_*.csv`, generated by
`final/scripts/22_metacommunity_results.R` from the frozen inputs in `config.R`.
Figures 18 and 19 are built by script 07. The earlier builder and outputs here
are retained without replacing their archived comparison.
